annotations.title: Get an event in compact form

description: Use when reading the compact form of get_event, including archived events. Up to 20 outcomes (leaders live, results first once closed), with the first outcome's rules. Untraded prices are absent. Winners require confirmation. `priced_outcome` names the priced side for non-Yes/No rows. See `cite_as` and `data_as_of`. Use get_event for full rows. Volume is in US dollars (notional: one share or contract pays $1) except on Manifold, which uses play-money mana. Check `quote_tier` in get_event or get_market before quoting.

event_id.description: Event ID native to the source. URL-encoded if it contains special chars.

format.description: Response format. JSON is the default.

source.description: Single venue ID. See get_status for public IDs.
